steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You're already down to your last few men.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: On any past battlefield, Victoria would've needed at least two or more Steam Knights in order to hold me off.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But look at yourselves now—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You're just a bunch of plain soldiers.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: —Hold formation!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Those who still have energy in your shields! Stand together with me!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Snipers, sustain fire, pin him!

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Yes, Captain!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I've said it before—no matter how strong he is, he's still just a flesh-and-blood Sarkaz Infected. His Arts have a limit!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You want to wait until I cast my body dry?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You'll never live to see me exhaust my strength.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Blake!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Horn, take my sword—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: —Got it.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: When they fall, they turn their gazes to you, still with hope.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I never thought I'd see such brilliance in Londinium again.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But how much longer can this fragile light persist?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Robben?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... No cause for alarm... falling here... just returning... returning... back to Londinium's land.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sarkaz!!!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You fired all of your remaining ammunition at once?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Well done. You've stopped me in my tracks for the first time.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But after this, you're out of tricks.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: After you watch your comrades die one by one, will you lose the will to fight too, White Wolf?

a.text: Rita.
I can understand how disappointed you are in your father.
Yes, a soldier's blood flows through my body.
But just as Victoria invented steam trains, yet only decades later abandoned steam—
Modern Victoria has taken off the crown meant for people to lift their gazes at, and no longer needs soldiers like your great-grandmother or me to fight for her.
There'll come a day the White Wolf, together with the Lion Padishah he accompanied, will be no more than indistinct images left in the history books.
Your father's taken note of that. He's ground down his own sharp claws so the family isn't torn apart by the tides of the ages.
But you're different.
You grow in a changing Victoria.
Rita Skamandros, you won't need to fight a landtrotter's campaign in the name of the Aslan King.
But Victoria is still your home.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sarkaz... So long as you occupy our cities, I will always have a reason to fight.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: My desire to defeat you is shared with every Victorian.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your shield is of little use now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I still have a sword.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your sword... heh, common as could be.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You want to battle me with a sword like this?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: *huff*... Don't underestimate it, or me.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You're so fond of remembering... the Steam Knights...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: When you take off the armor that Victoria forged them...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: They turn out just to be—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Victorians!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We actually... got inside? Why has this wall turned so soft?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Not bad! For an instant back there, I thought I was gonna get my head painted over Londinium's walls!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It was Misery's Arts. He wouldn't see us hurt.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Right... Kal'tsit told me your brain was an important asset to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: My hands don't come cheap either, c'mon!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: After that, I'm never asking to hitchhike with you again... Blaze carrying me everywhere is a way smoother ride than your Arts!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Am I right or am I right, Doctor?

options: Your hands are always busy. That's gotta be something.
I wouldn't say the Blaze Express is THAT comfortable.
You'd better take a breather, Misery.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I agree. Misery, I saw it clearly... Manfred almost impaled you with that thrust.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: That was just a desperation blow. He had no other move.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: You successfully provoked his rage, and that made him overlook my approach. I didn't even think I could fool him twice.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I didn't at all intend to...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When he asked me that, I definitely felt his anger. That rage of his rushed at me like a heatwave.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: If Manfred uses all his strength, anyone nearby would have trouble lasting for long. Best I... *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Misery, I know you want to help that Victorian officer, but using large-scale matter-transformation Arts several times in one day is too taxing on your body.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: It's okay, Amiya.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: I won't drop dead for a while yet. Besides, I promised Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You elite operators... make plenty of promises to Dr. Kal'tsit, don't you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Inject these emergency meds into yourself. The fight in Londinium's only just begun, and I don't want to see you off somewhere alone again, swallowing down all the blood you're practically throwing up.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Amiya, enemies inbound.

options: Feist, tie up six ziplines to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm. Misery found us a weak point in Londinium's defense system... We need to see this control room destroyed.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Blistering speed—White Wolf, this was your true aim, wasn't it?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Fangs and claws as fierce as these, yet tamed by Victoria's noble etiquette... Was it really worth it?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sarkaz, wasn't your present appearance once packaged in so-called culture?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I hear your people used to look very different.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You can try your hardest, but you still cannot kill me. So long as this city's defenses continue to churn—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No. Wait. White Wolf, you're only stalling me!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You—You and Rhodes Island are collaborating again.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Do you know who they are? Do you know what that Cautus leader...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I only know—that they can stop you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: White Wolf, should you miraculously succeed today... you will witness a corner of Londinium's walls collapse, with your own eyes.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Is that what you want to see? From this moment on, the legend of Londinium everstanding may well no longer—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: From this moment on?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The fact you can be stood here means... the idea that Londinium has never fallen is nothing more than a self-reassuring joke.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Damn you! If those dukes outside take note of this—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Are you aware? You're finally showing a hint of panic in your face.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That goes to show my decision was the correct one.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If this wall... only exists to smother the screams of the Victorians from within, then it's already lost its founding purpose.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You ought to let those dukes hear!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hear... how our fellow citizens cry out under your slaughter!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: How... How much longer until we can go outside?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Oh... it feels like this passage is about to collapse... are we all going to die here?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Don't look down, and don't look back.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: If the fear gets too much, just stare at the way ahead.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: The signal light's still on. This is our hope that our soldiers lit for us.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: We wait for the light as it turns bright... and then we can catch sight of the sun in Londinium once again.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Their firepower's too strong—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Rockrock, we can't get any closer to the train.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The bombardment hasn't stopped... Can the people down below still hold out? How much time do we have left?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: There's been no word from the commander's end...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I... I believe in my family.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: That's the one and only reason I've kept on this far.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Bloody hell, I can't get these things off me!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: That's not it... You saw how fast they were a moment ago?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: He's slowing them on purpose, like he's... just watching how long we can run for...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What kind of sicko is he?
Mmm... listen to the sound of your breaths, your pulses. Are you finally tired out?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Is this... the honor of the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This isn't fit to be called a battle.
...Battle?
You seem to have the wrong idea.
The 'King of Sarkaz' isn't here, so I'm left with no matching opponent at all.

Would you converse with a meatbeast about glory or honor? When you know full well that hunting them serves to do nothing but excite your senses, that their only ultimate service is as an entrée on your dinner table?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You treat us... as prey?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You may be a Sarkaz, but slaughtering like this out of pure personal taste is still far too barbaric.
Do not appraise me by your understanding of culture. It would be the most hideous kind of slander to me.
Try and resist me, before the filthy rubble pummels you into mincemeat here.
I will borrow your blood to record your feelings at death's door... all your fear, unwillingness, anger... Let them burst forth upon me to your heart's content!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, get over here—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan, you fall back too.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You're going to stand in front of all of us, and resist him?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You're no match for him.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: And you're not planning to turn and flee, even if you'll be shredded in an instant, have your flesh leave the dullest stain in this whole tunnel?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Only if... you can all run faster than I can.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Because...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There is no because. I just want to do this.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: When the city above us falls towards us, I want to be the first to embrace it in that instant.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: If that's so...
The signal light in the passage seems to glow brighter.
Are her eyes failing her? Why is there starlight in Londinium's underground? No... how long have they gone without seeing the stars behind the clouds, even on the surface?
Siege blinks.
She suddenly realizes that is no star.
It is a button.
The detritus that caked it has been shaken off, and now it is shining, and she has the exact fortune to know what it does.
She was first brought underneath the palace at three years of age.
Her mentor carried her upon his back, using a tremendous paw to guide her in pushing this button.
Londinium's subterranean sprawled about its own muscle and bone, exposing to the future liege its veins and arteries, filled with life.
Over twenty years later—
She has found it for the second time.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Bombs mounted at all nodes!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, I've got our retreat ready!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Move it, they're in here, stop them—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya! Dammit, how are they coming so thick and fast... did Misery leave too late? Did they not stall Manfred?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll hold them off! All of you, go!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, give the detonator to me—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You won't have a chance to retreat unless I lock down these enemies!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Once you've successfully withdrawn, I'll blow up this control room straight away—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we can't wait any longer! Think of the Self-Salvation Corps' fighters, Victoria's soldiers, Lady Heidi and Siege's team...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And every single Victorian being bombarded right now! None of us can hold on anymore!

options: Tell me—when to push the detonator.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... These black lines are everywhere... I can't see anything!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, why are you... in front of me?

a.text: Because I want to be.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not... not the weak child I was anymore...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I won't drag you down anymore. I can withstand these Arts, and these flames.

a.text: I know.
You're so powerful now. Far more powerful than I am, probably.
But no matter how many opportunities you give me to choose...
No matter if we're confronted with a Draco's flames, or the fiery light of these explosions...
This is what I want to do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Oof... caught you!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Wondered why you asked me for those six ziplines, Doctor. This is what it was for?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It'll be hard to move about, but... oh well, not as if you run fast ordinarily...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Fly, my drones!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: How's that for a surprise, Doctor? In response to your demands, I've tinkered on my drones and finally developed—a people-towing glider function!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: There's a cap on its long-term use, but at least it'll get us safely on the ground—

options: Now's the time to dial up the explosions.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The control room—!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: They... did it...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How... How long ago did you tire out? You can't even brandish your sword now...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You really were doing nothing but... making a stand with all you had.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Anyone else with your wounds would be in a coma ten times over by now!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Now you realize? Slow, aren't you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, the explosion in the control room has affected the cannons. The batteries and the minor section of the wall structure here have all been severely damaged—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If we hang around here any longer, we'll fall!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Notify all hands, retreat!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What about this soldier?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I've defeated her already, but toppling her would require spending more effort still.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: And it's not worth spending the time here any longer.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ha... haha...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: White Wolf of Victoria, you are a worthy opponent.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Should you live to descend this city wall—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Then next time we meet, by my sword... I will send you to a death befittingly heroic.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Next time...
Will there be a next time?
Londinium's wall is falling down.
And so she endlessly falls too.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I... I did it.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Until... you all left...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...I did not fall.
Her blood flows out, and she almost loses the last speck of awareness she has.
But her body is as if a part of her sword and shield at this point, harder than steel, unbending unless shattered.
The weapon forged by Victoria still stands upon Londinium's wall.
So the soldier She tempered to fruition keeps her watch upon it too.
Until a corner of it crashes to its city's ground—
And she returns to the land that raised her.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Just how tall... is this wall?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Why is it like...
...I'm flying up?
Horn, can you still move? Grab my hand, quick!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Robben?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You're... not...

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Yes, I'm not dead! I was lucky enough to grab onto the outside structure when I fell, and then Mr. Misery here saved me again!

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Come, soldier. You haven't finished your fight yet.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You lot, honestly. You won't ever let me rest, will you?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Nope!

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn, don't shut your eyes! Don't forget, your soldier is still here! You can't fall!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben, you've turned as noisy as... as a certain someone, now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Oh, forget it... I've never been able to do anything about you lot.
Her vision becomes clear once again.
The city wall of Londinium is still there, and though its highest height is now adorned by the tiniest hole, it still seems as towering, as unyielding as ever.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What's that shaking?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Artillery finally do the underground structure in?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: No, that's not it.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This shaking's coming from underneath us—

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, what did you do?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I've found a path we can walk.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Is this whole tunnel... moving up?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: How? You'd think we'd know it could do that after living here for so long, right?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: There are always some 'locals' who'll know more than others.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That monster...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Is it still gonna come after?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It will.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But maybe not today.
So you found a new course to flee down?
Ah... but of course, but of course.
This scent... is it that Feline, giving it off?
No... so-called royal families are no more than a lie, so called to consolidate power and coin, as laughable as this nation's culture.
Even if she is that runaway's cub, the smell of her blood would be no different to any other Feline.
So, this completely different scent...
Interesting.
Does Theresis know about this?
You'll have no chance to verify for yourself.
Oh?
I remember who you are. You're that... little disciple by Theresis's side. Even if your teacher was stood right here, he would be troubled to apprehend me.
He's no longer fit to be my teacher anymore.
Hm?
This odor of cursecraft... So you've come too, Banshee? I'd thought you were in that city right now, playing games with my entourage.
Trifling, unpracticed Artists. They weren't enough to hinder my step.
*sigh*... That makes things tricky.
This underpass on the verge of collapse is no fine place for the Royal Court to congregate.
Am I nothing in his eyes? Just because I didn't learn my skills from Theresis, or have any noble blood?
This long-winded old man's genuinely pissed me off. I'm going to gift him a hundred bombs as a farewell present. Any of you have any objections?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...Report.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Rhodes Island's people have jumped out from the control room. They had that Cautus, so we couldn't snipe them—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: And the rebels in the underground tunnels?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Er, we detected an explosion from beneath... and the Sanguinarch hasn't returned yet.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Where is Hoederer?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: He's severely wounded, and currently unconscious.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Assemble what workers remain, and have them inspect the city defense systems and report the damages. We must be prepared to activate more batteries... and even the main cannons.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Surround the remaining individuals at the station. The surviving rebels will be sure to pass through there.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The... The scouts are reporting, they've detected another group rapidly closing in on the station—
Manfred, don't blame yourself too much. You've already tried your hardest.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What are you doing here—

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Rockrock, take a look at the city wall—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The defense artillery's been... shut down?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Send the signal!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: They're coming, they're all coming!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: But the Sarkaz... they're all rushing this way!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Stop them! Kill every last one!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: If we can just repel the Sarkaz, we can start up the train!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're not getting away that easily!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Ugh—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: How's the rebel army coming from that way too?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Is that reinforcements?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: A team's broken through the Sarkaz forces' blockade from the north side!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Who... Who called them in?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Did some of the Messengers we sent to the city center survive? Did they get to ask for help?

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: You've done a fine job, my Sudean friends!

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: You can leave the next battle to us now! We're more on the professional end!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The way they work... they must have loads of experience...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Is... Is that Rhodes Island's operator?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Break them up!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Make a passage, ensure the Self-Salvation fighters withdraw from the underpass safely!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Snipers, take down those signalers—

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: It's—Miss Montague!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Montague?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: That name rings a bell and a half! Some noble in the paper or something?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Don't get distracted!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No matter who they are, we're on the same side!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We can get through! Quick, lead everyone onto the train!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Oh, wow... Lady Heidi, we've made it...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Mm-hm, I told you. Our soldiers won't let us down.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: They're her people.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Did our Messengers get in contact with her?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: To be more precise, it was your Rhodes Island Messenger.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Dagda! Look, it's Dagda!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: That tart...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hm.
There among the crowd, Dagda sees them too.
She throws down the Sarkaz she's tussling with, and rushes through the passage made with no hesitation, arms reached out to her partners caked in grime.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I... I was so scared I'd be late.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, you weren't.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No matter when you come back, we could never call you late.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Bastard, you... you stormed off just like that, remember? I didn't even get to beat you up!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Hm... you're still in time to do it now.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Ay, Vina, did you know she'd come back?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I knew.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I get you hid it from Indra. She'd never take help from nobles' mercenaries unless it was critical as this, end-of-the-line type.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Stop griping about me and let's get these idiots dealt with first!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I never stopped here!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, I didn't finish... you could've at least given me a shout!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: *sigh* You had me wondering if Dagda was off in some corner again even while we were being killed! I was all ready to take the Sarkaz down with me!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm sorry, Morgan...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: This won't happen again. I swear.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Siege Group, fully assembled.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We just wait for the Doctor's lot to come back, and we can all get out of here together.
Everyone, we're back!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Fancy coming in from the sky, all of you...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We're touching down! Gangway, outta the way—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: G—Grab the zipline! Don't crash into the train, it's our only means of escaping alive!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've got the Doctor held, we're alright!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Safe landing!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We... We actually made it?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Commander, is Rockrock alright? Everyone evacuated out?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We have more survivors than anticipated.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It's thanks to you, Feist, and everyone you brought in from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hah... You see that, Old Bill?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No, don't you faint on the job now! The battle's still not done!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: If you can move, then come help me in the engine room!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There are still Sarkaz forces pursuing us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's nothing they can do, now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because we'll hold them off here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Right, damned right.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Commander, the train's setting off—

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: All ready?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Amiya, we're getting on!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Go!

a.text: Amiya?
Amiya, careful. The train's moving.
Amiya... what are you looking at?

steps.text: The Cautus girl does not reply to you. Her body is still. Even her breathing seems to have stopped.
You can tell she's shocked. She's never let emotions as unveiled and intense show before the operators. This moment is incomparable.
At the same time, the Sarkaz chasing the train all come to a halt.
They all turn their heads, looking in the same direction.
A Sarkaz enters the ruins.
All smoke seems to part at her feet, all sounds of fire suspended about her.
Only wind remains, growing stronger and fiercer.
The ash laden on the ground is blown about, some sticking to her attire, some smudging her pale hair. She seems not to mind at all, only silently gazing into a point of the ruins.
It seems to have once been part of the defense artillery. A jet-black fowlbeast is there now, perched atop the still-warm cannon mouth.
Most likely disturbed by the train picking up in speed, it shakes off its wings.
As if somewhat in response, the pale-haired Sarkaz turns around.
She should have no sight of who is aboard the train, but her expression is as if she has recognized who is looking at her.
Her face is so warm, yet her eyes are so filled with sorrow. The sorrow is so much; perhaps not all of it comes from her, but comes from the one who stares at her too.

a.text: Amiya, are you alright?

steps.text: The Cautus girl finally comes back to reality.
She still doesn't give you a response, and you're in no rush for her to give one.
In one ear, you hear the calls of fowlbeasts. You see a flock of them out of the window flapping through the air, rushing into the gale ahead of you.
The train takes you rapidly from the station.
The city wall, the war, and that pale-haired figure, all are left far, far behind you.
Rumble. Rumble. Rumble.
Is that the remnants of cannon fire lingering in your brain, the train bumping against the railway, or thunder in those gloomy clouds gathering not far away?
The center of Londinium is right before you.
And all of you are riding into this storm.
